equations.base: jump_t ~ Bern(hazard); mu_t = clip(mu_{t-1} + jump_t N(0, magnitude), 30, 170); d_t = max(0, mu_t + sigma N(0,1)); y_t = d_t + tau N(0,1)
equations.decision_dependent: level: g_t = 0.9 g_{t-1} + 0.35 lost_{t-1}; mu_t = clip(b_t - g_t, 30, 170); regime: hazard_t = hazard (1 + 6 * 1{stocked out at t-1})
equations.heavy: d_t = max(0, mu_t + sigma e_t); e_t ~ N(0,1) w.p. 1-0.05, (magnitude/sigma) T_3 w.p. 0.05 [variant student_t: e_t ~ standardized T_3 every period]
equations.multimodal: modes at mu_0 -+ magnitude/2 (three_mode adds mu_0); logit(w_t) walks by N(0, 1.2) when Bern(hazard); k_t ~ Cat(w_t); d_t = max(0, m_{k_t} + sigma N(0,1))
equations.outside_support: d_t truncated to mu_0 +- 2 sigma for t < 0.45T; thereafter an excursion of size magnitude beyond the historical extreme with probability hazard
equations.reversal: mu_t = mu_0 for t < c; mu_0 - direction * magnitude for t >= c; c ~ U{0.35T, 0.60T}; further reversals at rate hazard

bayes_est: as above; tuning sigma upward trades bias for a permanently wide margin
bayes_true: Gaussian likelihood and Gaussian predictive; the true innovation has infinite kurtosis, and sigma understates the realized spread
dro_moment: the ambiguity set is shape-free, but the mean and s.d. it is built from are the two least robust statistics available
ewma: a squared-error update is driven by the contaminated draws
rule_b: as EWMA, and slower to forget a contaminated draw
saa: an empirical quantile assumes no shape, so heavy tails cost it sample efficiency rather than correctness - but it still assumes the window is i.i.d.

bayes_true: unimodal predictive; it tracks the mixture mean, a level that almost never occurs
dro_emp: as SAA, with a ball around it
dro_moment: a mean and an s.d. cannot tell a wide unimodal demand from a narrow bimodal one, and the two have different optimal orders
saa: an empirical quantile represents a mixture directly, given a window long enough to contain both modes and short enough to be current

bayes_true: Gaussian demand around the mean; the history is truncated and the excursions are not Gaussian
dro_emp: BY CONSTRUCTION: the ball reweights observed values and can place no mass on an outcome that has never occurred
dro_moment: the worst case is a two-point distribution that need not sit on observed values, so unseen outcomes are priced
ewma: its margin comes from its own observed variance
saa: an empirical quantile cannot exceed the largest value ever observed

bayes_est: the same model form, parameters tuned
bayes_true: assumes geometric change times and Gaussian jump sizes; here the change time is a single draw in a known window and the jump is +-magnitude
dro_emp: the ball is around a history containing none of the post-reversal level
dro_moment: moments of a window straddling the reversal describe neither side
saa: i.i.d. window; a long quiet history makes the window confident just before it becomes wrong
